mainEntity.name: Do my files leave my device when I shift with Shifteo?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. All processing happens locally in your browser and files never leave your device.

mainEntity.name: Which image formats can I shift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shifteo shifts PNG, JPEG, WebP, and AVIF images with quality and resize controls.
